name: lineagescale
label: Lineage
description: Lineage for a library too big to draw at once. One song at a time: its sources above, its derivatives below, fans of hundreds collapsed into counted groups you open as a list. Plus a landing page of headline numbers and ranked lists (most derived, deepest chain, biggest mashup sources, most recently extended), where every number opens a list in the explorer: songs with or without lineage, any relationship kind as parent or child, rankings for any kind and role, families and their members, searchable, sortable and paged. Read-only; the whole-library graph view is untouched.
